BiblicalUsage: Jehosheba is an Israelitess, the daughter of Jehoram who hid Joash from Athaliah. In 2 Kings 11:2, Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jehosheba shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
